title: Strict scalar-unit augmentation for the open total-tensor map
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site small in the module universe, $B$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $V\in\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Write $j^*$ for restriction to $(\mathcal C/V,B_V)$, with $B_V=j^*B$, and $j_{B!}\dashv j^*$ for exact module extension by zero and restriction [def-pur-localized-ringed-site, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Let $A_\bullet=(A_n,q_{m,n})_{m\ge n\ge1}$ be a strict inverse system of commutative $B$-algebra sheaves with unital $B$-algebra maps, including identity and composition laws, and put $A_{n,V}=j^*A_n$ [def-weil-inverse-system]. All tensors are sheafified tensors of module sheaves, and all complexes are possibly unbounded cochain complexes with signed direct-sum total tensor [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For a $B_V$-complex $Q$ and a $B$-complex $F$ put
$$Q_n=Q\otimes_{B_V}A_{n,V},\quad F_n=F\otimes_BA_n,\quad G=\operatorname{Tot}(j_{B!}Q\otimes_BF),\quad G_V=\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes_{B_V}j^*F).$$
Let $\gamma^B:G\xrightarrow\sim j_{B!}G_V$ and the corresponding $\gamma^{A_n}$ be the ordinary slice tensor chain isomorphisms whose inverses are the open-unit transposes; on extension-presheaf generators their forward maps send $[x]_f\otimes y$ to $[x\otimes j^*y]_f$ [lem-sf-ringed-slice-tensor-generators, lem-sf-ringed-open-total-tensor-kflat]. Brackets mean the image of the direct-sum summand indexed by $f:W\to V$, followed by sheafification [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Use the coefficient-linear maps
$$r_{L,n}:(j_{B!}L)\otimes_BA_n\xrightarrow\sim j_{A_n!}(L\otimes_{B_V}A_{n,V}),\qquad [z]_f\otimes a\longmapsto[z\otimes j^*a]_f,$$
for complexes $L$ on $\mathcal C/V$, and the identity-on-summands scalar-restriction identification $\operatorname{Res}_{B\to A_n}j_{A_n!}\cong j_{B!}\operatorname{Res}_{B_V\to A_{n,V}}$ [lem-sf-cbc-slice-tensor-generator-coherence]. These preserve all quotient transitions. Define
$$T_n=\operatorname{Tot}(((j_{B!}Q)\otimes_B A_n)\otimes_{A_n}F_n),\quad S_n=\operatorname{Tot}(Q_n\otimes_{A_{n,V}}j^*F_n),\qquad \gamma_n=\gamma^{A_n}_{Q_n,F_n}\circ\operatorname{Tot}(r_{Q,n}\otimes1).$$

Regard $T_\bullet$ and $S_\bullet$ as strict $B$- and $B_V$-module towers by scalar restriction, with the transitions induced by $q_{m,n}$ on both tensor factors [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $J_B$ denote termwise $j_{B!}$ on strict $B_V$-module towers and $\Delta$ the constant-tower functor. Define scalar-unit tensor augmentations
$$c_T:\Delta G\longrightarrow T_\bullet,\qquad c_S:\Delta G_V\longrightarrow S_\bullet$$
by their homogeneous presheaf formulas $[x]_f\otimes y\mapsto([x]_f\otimes1)\otimes(y\otimes1)$ and $x\otimes z\mapsto(x\otimes1)\otimes(z\otimes1)$, extended by sheafification and direct-sum totalization. Then the maps $\gamma_n$ form a chain isomorphism of strict towers $\gamma_\bullet:T_\bullet\xrightarrow\sim J_BS_\bullet$, and
$$\gamma_\bullet\,c_T=J_B(c_S)\,\Delta(\gamma^B)$$
is an equality of maps of augmented strict complex systems. On every homogeneous extension generator, both routes have value $[(x\otimes1)\otimes(j^*y\otimes1)]_f$. These are statements about maps on sheafifications, without an assertion that sections of a tensor sheaf are the tensor of its sections. The equality respects the signed total differentials, every transition $q_{m,n}$, and naturality in $Q,F$. It remains an equality after localization of strict systems. No K-flatness, finite-Tor, constructibility, completeness, or commutation of $j_{B!}$ with inverse limits or products is assumed.

Agent refinement of the ordinary slice tensor construction: coefficient interchange and its strict scalar-unit augmentation, extracted from the returned item proof, steps 3, 6 and 7.

proof.text: Choose the scalar-unit pairings and their prescribed strict totals from lem-sf-open-tensor-scalar-unit-pairing. Choose the normalized ordinary and coefficient open comparisons for these totals from lem-sf-open-tensor-normalized-comparison. These are separate constructions: neither assumes the augmentation square.

A map out of the source total is determined on the homogeneous generators [x]_f tensor y. Transport along gammaBase inverse, transpose under the localized module extension-restriction adjunction, and test on every direct-sum inclusion and every pure tensor. The sheafification adjunction and TensorProduct.induction_on give the last extensionality test. The normalized formula for gammaBase and its inverse identity identify the transported generator with the original one.

Both composites of the augmentation square have the same value on every homogeneous generator. The upper route uses cT_generator then gamma_generator with coefficients 1,1. The lower route uses base_generator, naturality of the extension adjunction unit on cS, then cS_generator. Apply the preceding extensionality test, then natural-transformation extensionality in the input and tower indices.

Assemble Augmentation from the two constructions and the proved square. Its common_value is the upper-route generator computation. Its localized_square follows by applying the functor to the established equality; no limit or product preservation is involved.

No new nodes, no SGA citation, no re-split note. The source (Stacks 0E8I/0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor) is contextual; the strict augmentation equation is an agent-written refinement and the item says so. Steps 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 are correct. Step 1: the iterated generator test follows from bilinear-extension uniqueness applied twice (to the presheaf tensors, then over B to P_M); left adjoints preserve the small direct sums. Step 2: c_T and c_S are chain maps; I checked the signs per bidegree and the q(1)=1 transitions. Step 4: both orders give [(x⊗q a|)⊗(j^*y⊗q b|)]_f. Step 5: both routes give [(x⊗1)⊗(j^*y⊗1)]_f. Step 6: naturality, and localization is only applying a functor. Edge cases checked: Q=0, F=0, constant tower, objects with no map to V, several arrows to V, zero ring, non-surjective q, unbounded complexes. Fault 1 (C3/C4), fixed: step 3 said the bidegree components of lem-sf-ringed-open-total-tensor-kflat are the generator-normalized comparison. That statement's components are the iso of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor, which fixes no generator formula. Step 3 now totalizes psi of lem-sf-ringed-slice-tensor-generators degreewise, using that j_! preserves direct sums, naturality of psi under d⊗1 and 1⊗d, and the same (-1)^p on both sides. The K-flat lemma is dropped from the proof uses, proof_deps and tool_uses but stays in stmt_deps; step 5's wording now points to step 3.
